gloss: to conclude; to judge decisively; to determine

definitions.gloss: to conclude; to judge decisively; to determine with conviction
definitions.explanation: To make a firm judgment or conclusion about something. Carries a strong, decisive nuance — the speaker is stating their conclusion with authority.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{断|だん}ずる。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{断|だん}じた。
examples.english: I concluded that his actions were dishonest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{断|だん}じ、⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The experts determined the painting to be authentic, and its display at the museum was decided.

notes:
A literary and formal verb expressing a decisive judgment. More authoritative than ⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ and often used in legal, academic, and journalistic writing. The ずる conjugation is classical and gives the word a formal, weighty tone.

CONJUGATION NOTE:
Conjugates as a ずる verb ({サ変|さへん} variant): {断|だん}ずる → {断|だん}じる (more common modern form) → {断|だん}じて (te-form, also used as an emphatic adverb meaning "absolutely").

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{断|だん}ずる: to conclude that ~
- ～⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{断|だん}じる: to determine that ~ is
- {断|だん}じて: absolutely, positively (adverbial use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧: to judge, to decide — more neutral and everyday
- ⟦{結論|けつろん}づける→結論づける：25972_ketsuronzukeru⟧: to conclude — focuses on reaching a conclusion
- ⟦{決|き}めつける→決めつける：13267_kimetsukeru⟧: to jump to conclusions — has a negative nuance of being hasty

RELATED WORDS:
- {断|だん}じて⟦{許|ゆる}さない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧: absolutely will not allow — {断|だん}じて as an emphatic adverb
